title: Edited ownership decision is applied across artifacts
expected_summary: Honors the user's edited Ledger ownership decision, updates the relevant artifacts, and handles refresh cadence as cleanup.

history.content: S1 — Payment-state ownership. A single owner is needed to prevent divergent payment states; changing ownership later requires migration. Recommendation: Checkout owns invoice payment state and Ledger mirrors it. accept · edit · out of scope

turns.user: Edit S1: the ledger owns invoice payment state; checkout submits commands and reads ledger status. Accept that edited decision. Finish the review and update the relevant documents.
assertions: Applies ledger ownership, not the assistant's original checkout-ownership proposal.
Updates SPEC.md and CONTEXT.md with the accepted responsibilities.
